note: Group A of the explainer films (tashir, sevan, ani, mari, sis, gyumri, halidzor), merged into scripts.json's by tts.py: the same fields (cuts, lexicon, spoken), and each battlefield's title (docs) and music bed (its opening tune in the game, REC_OPEN, from this second).

Smbat.note: No vowel before the m, as in Armenian; a recognizer writes 'Sambaat'.

Akhurian.note: The Armenian kh is softened to k: with it, a recognizer wrote 'Ahuryan'.

Hethum.note: Said with the English th, a recognizer writes it as spelled; with a plain t it wrote 'Hetun'.

Thoros.note: With a plain t a recognizer wrote 'Tauros'.

Sis.note: With a long ee a recognizer wrote 'cease'.
